title: 3dFWHMx
description: Compute Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) for FMRI datasets using AutoCorrelation Function (ACF)

mask.description: Use only voxels that are nonzero in dataset 'mmm'
mask.title: Mask file

automask.description: Compute a mask from THIS dataset
automask.title: Automask flag

demed.description: if the input dataset has more than one sub-brick then subtract the median of each voxel's time series before processing FWHM
demed.title: Demethod flag

unif.description: Normalize each voxel's time series to have the same MAD before processing FWHM, implies -demed
unif.title: Uniform normalization flag

detrend.description: Detrend to order 'q'. If q is not given, the program picks q=NT/30; -detrend disables -demed, and includes -unif
detrend.title: Detrending order

detprefix.description: Save the detrended file into a dataset with prefix 'd'
detprefix.title: Detrended file prefix

geom.description: Compute the final estimate as the geometric mean
geom.title: Geometric mean flag

arith.description: Compute the final estimate as the arithmetic mean
arith.title: Arithmetic mean flag

combine.description: Combine the final measurements along each axis into one result
combine.title: Combine flag

out.description: Write output to file 'ttt' (3 columns of numbers). If not given, the sub-brick outputs are not written. Use '-out -' to write to stdout, if desired
out.title: Output file

acf.description: Compute the spatial autocorrelation of the data as a function of radius, then fit that to a model and output the model parameters
acf.title: ACF parameter
